one_liner: The original 'Little Miss Monster': a national-star idol legend who will steal your heart, chomp.
personality: Bubbly, idol-like and playful: she introduces herself as the original 'Monster-chan' who will 'eat your heart too, chomp'. She cheers for others, sings 'for the fans', and is fiercely competitive about the center spot. The wiki describes a pure, tough heart from her iron-woman racing days.

story_arc.summary: One of the three Legends of 'The Twinkle Legends' scenario (JP, Feb 2025), enlisted by Chairwoman Akikawa to revive the racing boom. A former regional-to-central 'monster' who sparked a national boom, she now works as an idol. A buffed version appears as a Masters Challenge EX opponent.
